```{r map-participants}
reindex_participants <- function(data) {
  unique_ids <- sort(unique(data$participant_id))
  lookup <- tibble::tibble(
    original_id = unique_ids,
    participant_id_new = sprintf("%02d", seq_along(unique_ids))
  )

  data_reindexed <- data %>%
    left_join(lookup, by = c("participant_id" = "original_id")) %>%
    mutate(participant_id = coalesce(participant_id_new, participant_id)) %>%
    select(-participant_id_new)

  list(data = data_reindexed, lookup = lookup %>% rename(participant_id = participant_id_new))
}

sub1_reindexed <- reindex_participants(sub1)
sub2_reindexed <- reindex_participants(sub2)
sub3_reindexed <- reindex_participants(sub3)

sub1 <- sub1_reindexed$data
sub2 <- sub2_reindexed$data
sub3 <- sub3_reindexed$data

participant_id_record <- bind_rows(
  mutate(sub1_reindexed$lookup, subset = "Sub1"),
  mutate(sub2_reindexed$lookup, subset = "Sub2"),
  mutate(sub3_reindexed$lookup, subset = "Sub3")
)

cat("Participant ID mapping (original -> new):\n")
print(participant_id_record)
```

```{r prepare-plot-data}
parse_resp_num <- function(x) {
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(x)
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("\\[|\\]", "", as.character(x))))
}

flag_to_bool <- function(x) {
  if (is.logical(x)) return(x)
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(x != 0)
  str <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  str %in% c("1", "true", "yes", "y")
}

circ_stats_safe <- function(theta_rad) {
  theta_rad <- theta_rad[!is.na(theta_rad)]
  n <- length(theta_rad)
  if (n == 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble(R = NA_real_, std_circ = NA_real_, std_circ_deg = NA_real_, variance = NA_real_, SEr = NA_real_, SEs = NA_real_))
  }
  C <- sum(cos(theta_rad))
  S <- sum(sin(theta_rad))
  R_raw <- sqrt(C^2 + S^2) / n
  if (!is.finite(R_raw)) {
    R_raw <- NA_real_
  }
  R_clamped <- if (is.na(R_raw)) NA_real_ else min(max(R_raw, .Machine$double.eps), 1)
  std_circ <- if (is.na(R_clamped)) NA_real_ else sqrt(-2 * log(R_clamped))
  std_circ_deg <- if (is.na(std_circ)) NA_real_ else std_circ * (180 / pi)
  variance <- if (is.na(R_raw)) NA_real_ else 1 - R_raw
  SEr <- if (is.na(R_raw)) NA_real_ else sqrt(max(0, 1 - R_raw^2)) / sqrt(n)
  SEs <- if (is.na(R_clamped) || R_clamped <= 0) NA_real_ else (1 / (R_clamped * sqrt(-2 * log(R_clamped)))) * SEr
  tibble::tibble(R = R_raw, std_circ = std_circ, std_circ_deg = std_circ_deg, variance = variance, SEr = SEr, SEs = SEs)
}

prepare_subset_for_plots <- function(data) {
  mutated <- data %>%
    mutate(
      rt_ms = parse_resp_num(response_RT_from_start),
      precision_deg = parse_resp_num(response_error_deg),
      abs_precision_deg = abs(precision_deg),
      theta_rad = precision_deg * (pi / 180),
      abs_precision_radian = abs_precision_deg * (pi / 180),
      too_fast_flag = flag_to_bool(too_fast_trigger),
      too_slow_flag = flag_to_bool(too_slow_trigger)
    )

  filtered <- mutated %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(participant_id),
      !too_fast_flag,
      !too_slow_flag,
      !is.na(rt_ms),
      between(rt_ms, 300, 3000),
      !is.na(precision_deg)
    )

  filter_stats <- list(
    total = nrow(mutated),
    missing_pid = sum(is.na(mutated$participant_id)),
    too_fast = sum(mutated$too_fast_flag, na.rm = TRUE),
    too_slow = sum(mutated$too_slow_flag, na.rm = TRUE),
    missing_rt = sum(is.na(mutated$rt_ms)),
    rt_below = sum(mutated$rt_ms < 300, na.rm = TRUE),
    rt_above = sum(mutated$rt_ms > 3000, na.rm = TRUE),
    retained = nrow(filtered)
  )

  participant_stats <- filtered %>%
    group_by(participant_id) %>%
    summarise(
      circ = list(circ_stats_safe(theta_rad)),
      mean_rt = mean(rt_ms, na.rm = TRUE),
      abs_mean = mean(abs_precision_deg, na.rm = TRUE),
      trials = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::unnest_wider(circ)

  data_with_stats <- filtered %>%
    left_join(participant_stats, by = "participant_id")

  list(data = data_with_stats, filter_stats = filter_stats)
}

print_filter_stats <- function(label, stats) {
  cat(sprintf("%s: retained %d/%d trials after RT bounds and flag filtering.\n", label, stats$retained, stats$total))
  cat(sprintf("  - missing participant_id: %d\n", stats$missing_pid))
  cat(sprintf("  - too fast flag: %d\n", stats$too_fast))
  cat(sprintf("  - too slow flag: %d\n", stats$too_slow))
  cat(sprintf("  - missing RT: %d\n", stats$missing_rt))
  cat(sprintf("  - RT < 300ms: %d\n", stats$rt_below))
  cat(sprintf("  - RT > 3000ms: %d\n", stats$rt_above))
}

sub1_prep <- prepare_subset_for_plots(sub1)
sub2_prep <- prepare_subset_for_plots(sub2)
sub3_prep <- prepare_subset_for_plots(sub3)

sub1 <- sub1_prep$data
sub2 <- sub2_prep$data
sub3 <- sub3_prep$data

attr(sub1, "subset_key") <- "sub1"
attr(sub2, "subset_key") <- "sub2"
attr(sub3, "subset_key") <- "sub3"

print_filter_stats("Sub1", sub1_prep$filter_stats)
print_filter_stats("Sub2", sub2_prep$filter_stats)
print_filter_stats("Sub3", sub3_prep$filter_stats)
```

```{r filter-preview}
# Example filtering steps for downstream analyses; edit and add new filters as needed.
sub1_total <- nrow(sub1)
sub1_no_cue <- sum(is.na(sub1$cue_type) | trimws(sub1$cue_type) == "")
sub1_filtered <- sub1 %>%
  filter(!is.na(cue_type) & trimws(cue_type) != "")

sub2_total <- nrow(sub2)
allowed_sets <- c(2, 4, 6)
sub2_invalid_set <- sum(is.na(sub2$num_items) | !(sub2$num_items %in% allowed_sets))
sub2_filtered <- sub2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(num_items), num_items %in% allowed_sets)

sub3_total <- nrow(sub3)
sub3_missing_rt <- sum(is.na(sub3$response_RT_from_start))
sub3_filtered <- sub3 %>%
  filter(!is.na(response_RT_from_start))

cat(sprintf("sub1: removed %d/%d rows with empty cue_type (retained %d).\n",
            sub1_no_cue, sub1_total, nrow(sub1_filtered)))
cat(sprintf("sub2: removed %d/%d rows outside set sizes %s (retained %d).\n",
            sub2_invalid_set, sub2_total, paste(allowed_sets, collapse = ", "), nrow(sub2_filtered)))
cat(sprintf("sub3: removed %d/%d rows with missing RT (retained %d).\n",
            sub3_missing_rt, sub3_total, nrow(sub3_filtered)))
```

```{r plot-limits, include=FALSE}
bin_hist_max <- function(values, breaks) {
  values <- values[!is.na(values)]
  if (length(values) == 0) return(0)
  h <- hist(values, breaks = breaks, plot = FALSE)
  if (length(h$counts) == 0) return(0)
  max(h$counts, na.rm = TRUE)
}

max_bin_per_subset <- function(data, field, breaks) {
  counts <- data %>%
    group_by(participant_id) %>%
    summarise(max_bin = bin_hist_max(.data[[field]], breaks), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pull(max_bin)
  if (length(counts) == 0) return(0)
  max(counts, na.rm = TRUE)
}

precision_breaks <- seq(0, 180, by = 5)
precision_xlim <- c(0, 180)
precision_ylim_map <- list(
  sub1 = c(0, max(1, max_bin_per_subset(sub1, "abs_precision_deg", precision_breaks), na.rm = TRUE)),
  sub2 = c(0, max(1, max_bin_per_subset(sub2, "abs_precision_deg", precision_breaks), na.rm = TRUE)),
  sub3 = c(0, max(1, max_bin_per_subset(sub3, "abs_precision_deg", precision_breaks), na.rm = TRUE))
)

rt_breaks <- seq(300, 3000, by = 50)
rt_xlim <- c(300, 3000)
rt_ylim_map <- list(
  sub1 = c(0, max(1, max_bin_per_subset(sub1, "rt_ms", rt_breaks), na.rm = TRUE)),
  sub2 = c(0, max(1, max_bin_per_subset(sub2, "rt_ms", rt_breaks), na.rm = TRUE)),
  sub3 = c(0, max(1, max_bin_per_subset(sub3, "rt_ms", rt_breaks), na.rm = TRUE))
)

precision_limits_for <- function(data) {
  key <- attr(data, "subset_key")
  if (is.null(key) || !key %in% names(precision_ylim_map)) {
    key <- "sub1"
  }
  list(x = precision_xlim, y = precision_ylim_map[[key]])
}

rt_limits_for <- function(data) {
  key <- attr(data, "subset_key")
  if (is.null(key) || !key %in% names(rt_ylim_map)) {
    key <- "sub1"
  }
  list(x = rt_xlim, y = rt_ylim_map[[key]])
}
```


```{r plotting-utils, include=FALSE}
plot_precision_dist <- function(data, sub_label, pid) {
  participant_data <- data %>% filter(participant_id == pid)
  if (nrow(participant_data) == 0) return(NULL)

  circ_sd <- participant_data$std_circ_deg[1]
  abs_mean <- participant_data$abs_mean[1]
  if (length(circ_sd) == 0 || is.na(circ_sd)) circ_sd <- NA_real_
  if (length(abs_mean) == 0 || is.na(abs_mean)) abs_mean <- NA_real_

  limits <- precision_limits_for(data)
  ggplot(participant_data, aes(x = abs_precision_deg)) +
    geom_histogram(breaks = precision_breaks, fill = "steelblue3", color = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
    labs(
      title = paste(sub_label, "-", pid),
      subtitle = sprintf("circSD = %.2f° | Abs Mean = %.2f°", circ_sd, abs_mean),
      x = "Absolute precision (deg)",
      y = "Trial count"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = limits$x, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = limits$y, expand = c(0, 0))
}

plot_RT_dist <- function(data, sub_label, pid) {
  participant_data <- data %>% filter(participant_id == pid)
  if (nrow(participant_data) == 0) return(NULL)

  mean_rt <- mean(participant_data$rt_ms, na.rm = TRUE)
  median_rt <- median(participant_data$rt_ms, na.rm = TRUE)

  limits <- rt_limits_for(data)
  ggplot(participant_data, aes(x = rt_ms)) +
    geom_histogram(breaks = rt_breaks, fill = "tomato2", color = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = mean_rt, linetype = "dashed", color = "navy") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = median_rt, linetype = "dotted", color = "darkgreen") +
    labs(
      title = paste(sub_label, "-", pid),
      subtitle = sprintf("RT distribution (mean %.0f ms / median %.0f ms)",
                         ifelse(is.na(mean_rt), NA_real_, mean_rt),
                         ifelse(is.na(median_rt), NA_real_, median_rt)),
      x = "Response time (ms)",
      y = "Trial count"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = limits$x, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = limits$y, expand = c(0, 0))
}

render_participant_logits <- function(plot_fn, data, sub_label) {
  participants <- sort(unique(data$participant_id))
  purrr::walk(participants, function(pid) {
    plot_obj <- plot_fn(data, sub_label, pid)
    if (!is.null(plot_obj)) print(plot_obj)
  })
}
```

```{r group-level-plots}
pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.6)
pj <- position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.6, jitter.width = 0.15, seed = 42)

plot_group_precision <- function(data, label) {
  summary <- data %>%
    distinct(participant_id, duration_ms, std_circ_deg, cue_type) %>%
    group_by(duration_ms, cue_type) %>%
    summarise(cirSD = mean(std_circ_deg, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  ggplot(data, aes(x = factor(duration_ms), y = abs_precision_deg, fill = cue_type, color = cue_type)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, position = pd, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(position = pj, alpha = 0.35, size = 0.9) +
    geom_point(data = summary, inherit.aes = FALSE,
               aes(x = factor(duration_ms), y = cirSD, group = cue_type),
               shape = 21, color = "black", fill = "white", size = 3, position = pd) +
    labs(title = paste(label, "precision (abs error)"),
         subtitle = "CirSD (deg) shown as points, jittered trials for raw spread",
         x = "Encoding duration (ms)", y = "Absolute precision (deg)") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) paste0(x, " ms")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
}

plot_group_rt <- function(data, label) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = factor(duration_ms), y = rt_ms, fill = cue_type, color = cue_type)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, position = pd, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(position = pj, alpha = 0.35, size = 0.9) +
    labs(title = paste(label, "RT distribution"),
         subtitle = "RT spread with jittered points (no axis limits)",
         x = "Encoding duration (ms)", y = "Response time (ms)") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) paste0(x, " ms")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
}

plot_group_precision(sub1e1, "Sub1e1")
plot_group_rt(sub1e1, "Sub1e1")
plot_group_precision(sub2e1, "Sub2e1")
plot_group_rt(sub2e1, "Sub2e1")
plot_group_precision(sub3e1, "Sub3e1")
plot_group_rt(sub3e1, "Sub3e1")
```
